categories.title: Every detector missed a near person
categories.about: The person is in view and less than 6 m away, and no detector finds them. Largest true boxes first.

categories.title: Only one detector found the person
categories.about: Exactly one detector hits. Farthest first.

categories.title: Low light on the fisheye: every detector hit
categories.about: Dusk, night, or IR on the fisheye camera, and all detectors find the person.

categories.title: One pair for each light
categories.about: For each light: the farthest frame where most detectors hit, and the nearest frame where all miss.

categories.title: False alarms with no person
categories.about: Person boxes in scenes with a dog, a passing car, or nobody. Highest scores first.

categories.title: Boxes away from the person
categories.about: Counted person boxes that do not match the true box. Some are on the visible part of a partly hidden person (see Scoring notes on the Benchmark page).

categories.title: Best and worst scenarios
categories.about: The scenarios with the highest and lowest mean detection rate (a middle frame).
